result.summary: The main visual issue is that the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the scrolling restaurant content, obscuring a substantial portion of the next popular restaurant card.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlays the pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the screen, hiding part of its image and any content that would appear below it.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/inset to the scrollable feed so cards can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.
